# Provider fixtures

**Status: synthetic.** These files were generated by `scripts/make_synthetic_fixtures.py`
in the exact response shape of Mapbox Directions v5, Mapbox Geocoding v6 and Open-Meteo,
because no API key or network access was available when the adapters were written.
Coordinates follow real corridors (I-80, I-70, US-40 between Denver and Salt Lake City), but
the geometry is not road-accurate and the weather is made up.

To replace them with real recordings (needs `MAPBOX_TOKEN`; tokens are stripped):

```bash
cd backend && uv run python scripts/record_fixtures.py
```

`open_meteo/nulls.json` stays synthetic on purpose: it pins the null-handling path.
